ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the recent $11M case.
questions: How is Medicaid fraud being perpetrated in Minnesota?
What are the financial implications of these cases?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and patterns in these cases, we may be able to identify potential vulnerabilities in the system and prevent future fraud.
